last_scene.summary: Arlequino performed the user-supplied lyrics of 'Кукла колдуна' after the remaining magical audience groups were established as заклинатели, целители and simply маги. The performance played as an energetic theatrical horror-story rather than a technical description of magic. Real listener patterns for the original song support strong attachment to its memorable character/story and also mixed responses to its distinctive opening/arrangement, so crowd response remained heterogeneous. The magical groups reacted differently to the supplied text: some mages enjoyed the escalating mystery and the reveal of the controlling sorcerer; healers were more uneasy at the image of a person being used like a puppet; some enchanter-type listeners argued or joked about whether such control should even be called sorcery. The unfamiliar cross reference was treated only as a strange protective charm/symbol in the song, without importing Earth religion into NPC knowledge. The final warning that staying there was dangerous landed as a clean theatrical ending. Tips +22s48c; expenses 0; net +22s48c. Personal cash became 21g73s22c.
